analysis_packet.certificate: Source-anonymous synthesis sealed: preserve substantive behavioral evidence while exposing no generative attribution. Hard legality and capacity obligations take precedence over heuristic objectives; online adaptation must remain bounded by directly observable request state.
exact_actions: Construct the terminal policy from the sealed behavioral obligations and source-anonymous evidence only.
Audit every insertion, promotion, replacement, and eviction against resident-byte accounting and unique-key invariants.
Audit oversized, zero-capacity, zero-size, repeated-hit, ghost-hit, and phase-transition behavior separately.
Ensure returned eviction lists are generated solely from actual resident removals during the current access.
Retain online-only adaptive state, but exclude any mechanism that requires future requests, hidden traces, oracle decisions, or external artifacts.
Emit one complete policy satisfying the interface and constraints; preserve unresolved objective tradeoffs as explicit heuristic choices rather than unsupported guarantees.
obligations: Preserve the exact public interface and standard-library-only implementation boundary.
Normalize and safely account for capacity, keys, and sizes without allowing negative accounting or capacity overflow.
Maintain unique resident membership and ensure every returned eviction key is actually removed from resident state.
Handle an object larger than capacity without retaining it, while preserving correct eviction reporting for an already resident object being removed.
Keep nonresident ghost evidence separate from resident occupancy and exclude ghost bytes from capacity usage.
Use adaptive recency/frequency treatment only as an online heuristic, while preserving distinctions between scan resistance, repeated reuse, byte cost, and phase shifts.
Treat hard contract legality and capacity safety as non-negotiable when objectives conflict.
Do not recover, reveal, or condition decisions on the provenance of any supplied claim.
witnesses: The required interface is Policy(capacity_bytes) with access(key, size, now) returning a list of integer eviction keys.
Resident state must be represented by unique keys whose summed normalized sizes never exceed nonnegative capacity.
Eviction outputs must contain only keys resident immediately before the corresponding removal, with no duplicates or metadata-only keys.
Recent and frequent resident classes, ghost histories, adaptive partitioning, variable object sizes, oversized requests, zero capacity, and zero-sized objects are substantively distinct cases.
The competing objectives create real tensions among hit rate, byte hit rate, scan resistance, phase adaptation, and regret; these must not be collapsed into a single unsupported claim.
All decisions must use only the current access and policy-maintained online state, with no trace, oracle, benchmark, external library, networking, or subprocess dependence.
